text_raw: I took some effort to write this So read till end and comment back . Ee movie avarage and ala vaikuntapuram is director bestwork aa . It seems someone gave money to u for exaggerate AVPL movie . Ala vaikuntapuram lo murali sharma peru valmiki pettadam great brain work ani cheppav , actually valmiki transformers into good but here Murali sharma does not become good ( as he still wants his son to be in rich house ) so comparison is wrong . Actual Vaikuntapuram lo Vishnu and laxmi devi chaala happy ga untaru ikkada okka scene lo unataru so ee comparison kuda wrong . Actual Vaikuntapuram lo Lord Vishnu is boss ikada ala kadu . Here Jayaram is talented employee who was chosen as son in-law because tabu has no interest in taking company and rest of family members are not capable of doing so Again comparison is not correct . Story lo stabbing scene lo main office cc camera Undadu . Sushant charecter ki oka justification aa undadhu . Jayaram allu arjun ki chala depth unna dialogues cheppestadu ( greatest war is with close people ) kani thanaki close ina kodukotho koncham supportive gaa kuda matladadu . Adi ala undi ante I will give an eg Avg marks vachina student father velli 1st rank student ki vadi kastalu chepte ala untado ala ne undi antha illogical ga . ( Of course hero saved Jayaram but still it felt ill logical ) Fights lo anti gravity elements chaalaa untayi eve fights ballayya cheste troll chestaru ade ee movie lo manam ala anakudadu ani hero style gaa undi ani convince chestadu , malli nuvvu dappu ee movie ki NO ACCURATE Ending . Hero antadu Money kosam avrino amma analenu and pechina amma aunty analenu . Ending lo hero company ki Ceo ipotadu but that is not he wants He wants his own parents to be HAPPY and dont want to leave murali sharma s wife but opposite happens . Murali sharma wife ki tana koduku duram ipoyadane bada undadhu , nenu chesina vanta tinadaniki okadu unte chalu annattu chupistaru last scene lo Let me ask Tell me points which trivikram did research while writing this story And in Hit movie you can see director definitely did research on some points like lie detector permission , calligraphy studying , ptsd problem , taking Dna from people , how police department works and how police find clues . Hit review lo nv okati cheppav Hero very good at find clues but story lo adi kanipinchadu ani . Case lo hero findout chese evidence mottam rohit misplace chestadu so it will be difficult for hero to find culprit E cinema Avpl 5 years back vachina trend la ne undi like Family lo kontha mandi emotional gaa duram ipotaru hero valli kaluputadu Same story line unna movies Brundavanam Pandaga chesko Govindudu andarivade le Rabhasa Sathamanam bavathi etc E movies annitilo chudu hero strive to bring some people together this story is falls in same category . Hero ni at time of birth marchestru peddayaka aa vishayam telustadi and his own parents emotional close ga undaru vallani kalipi valla company ni take over chestadu Peddaga kothadanam ami ledu . Review lo nv hero ramudi la nijame cheptadu ani annav Ramudu ki unde quality hero ki undadhu pariyi stree ni chudadu ikada hero 2nd herione tho andhuku matladatado clarity undadu My whole point is to disagree to point that is ala vaikuntapuram lo is great and hit is avarage . Small bugdet cinema intha baga tisadu ani cheppakunda Arey pedda ee cinema bavundanta pada pogideddam annattu chesav ne review
